Input: `OUTPUT/rds/target_demoData.rds` (01)  
Output: `OUTPUT/rds/spe.rds`

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
source("Setup.R")
```

```{r}
target_demoData <- readRDS(file.path(path_rds, "target_demoData.rds"))

spex <- geomx_to_spe(target_demoData)
spe <- readGeoMxFromDGE(edgeR::SE2DGEList(spex))
spe <- add_sample_labels(spe)
spe
```

```{r}
saveRDS(spe, file = file.path(path_rds, "spe.rds"))
```
